topic: What if you fell into a black hole? The pull on your feet would be much stronger than on your head, stretching you like spaghetti (spaghettification).

episode.title: What If You Fell Into a Black Hole?

shots.narration: What if you fell feetfirst into a black hole?
shots.scene: Colourful 3D science lab, vertical frame, glowing black hole hologram without text.
shots.action: nova presents the black hole hologram to byte.
shots.mood: Bright cyan lighting, curious expressions, dramatic swirling orange glow.

shots.narration: Let's explore safely, using an empty spacesuit.
shots.scene: Colourful lab beside a holographic black hole, visibly empty transparent demonstration spacesuit.
shots.action: nova places the miniature empty spacesuit into the hologram.
shots.mood: Playful laboratory demonstration, soft blue highlights, reassuring atmosphere.

shots.narration: [excited] Gravity pulls the suit toward the black hole.
shots.scene: Close view of the floating hologram, empty spacesuit aligned boots toward the black hole.
shots.action: The empty spacesuit drifts boots-first toward the dark sphere.
shots.mood: Vivid cosmic colours, fascinated robot expression, clear spatial arrangement.

shots.narration: Its feet are closer, so gravity pulls them harder.
shots.scene: Lab hologram showing an empty spacesuit beside a black hole, large glowing arrow at boots and smaller arrow at helmet, no labels.
shots.action: nova points at the larger arrow beside the boots.
shots.mood: Crisp educational lighting, bright contrasting arrows, attentive expressions.

shots.narration: That difference stretches the suit from head to toe.
shots.scene: Magnified hologram of the empty flexible demonstration spacesuit above the lab table.
shots.action: The holographic suit elongates between its helmet and boots.
shots.mood: Rubbery cartoon demonstration, luminous blue material, curious rather than frigh

shots.scene: Colourful lab with a tall holographic empty spacesuit, elongated into a thin noodle-like shape.
shots.action: byte tilts sideways beside the stretched hologram.
shots.mood: Comical robot expression, cheerful purple and turquoise lighting.

shots.narration: These tidal forces grow stronger as you approach the center.
shots.scene: Lab hologram with a black hole and an empty demonstration suit positioned closer to its center.
shots.action: The empty suit stretches further toward the black hole.
shots.mood: Clear visual progression, saturated cosmic glow, calm scientific curiosity.

shots.narration: The event horizon marks the boundary of no return.
shots.scene: Black hole hologram with a thin highlighted spherical event horizon, no lettering or markings.
shots.action: nova traces the highlighted boundary with her fingertip.
shots.mood: Elegant blue boundary glow, thoughtful expressions, wondrous atmosphere.

shots.narration: [whispers] Even light cannot escape; what if Earth stopped spinning?
shots.scene: Colourful lab with light paths confined inside the black hole hologram and a stationary Earth hologram beside it.
shots.action: nova reveals the stationary Earth hologram to byte.
shots.mood: Surprising cosmic reveal, bright planetary colours, eager anticipation.

episode.description: Dr. Nova shows Byte how a black hole could stretch a falling object like spaghetti. Explore tidal forces, spaghettification, and the boundary beyond which even light cannot escape.
